applications.source_text: (እሉ፡) ወ*ባዕዳን፡ *ኵሉ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ [ወ]ነሥኡ፡ ሎሙ፡ አንስተ፡ ወኃረዩ፡ ኵሉ፡ ለለ፡ ርእሱ፡ አሐተ፤ ወወጠኑ፡ ይብኡ፡ ኀቤሆን፡ ወ*ተደመሩ፡ ምስሌሆን፡ ወመሀርዎን፡ ሥረያተ፡ ወ*ሥብያተ፡ ወመቲረ፡ ስርው፡ ወዕፀወ፡ አመርዎን።
applications.english: These and all the others with them took wives for themselves, and each chose one for himself. Then they began to go in to them and join themselves to them.[a] They taught them charms and incantations,[b] the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants.[c]

applications.source_text: ወአማንትሰ፡ ፀንሳ፡ ወወለዳ፡ *ረዓይተ፡ ዓበይተ፡ ወ*ቆሞሙ፡ በበ፡ ፴፻፡ በአመት።
applications.english: And they conceived and gave birth to great giants, whose height was three thousand cubits each.[a][b]

applications.source_text: እለ፡ በልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ጻማ፡ ሰብእ፡ †እስከ፡† ስእኑዎሙ፡ *ሰብእ፡ ሴስዮቶ።
applications.english: They devoured all the fruit of human labor, until people were unable to feed them.[a][b]
And the giants turned against them and devoured humankind.[a]

applications.source_text: ወወጠኑ፡ የአብሱ፡ በአዕዋፍ፡ ወዲበ፡ አራዊት፡ ወበዘይትሐወሥ፡ ወበዓሳተ፡ ሠጋሆሙ፡ በበይናቲሆሙ፡ ይትባለዑ፡ ወደመ፡ ይስተዩ፡ [እምኔሃ፡]
applications.english: They began to sin against the birds and the wild animals, against every creeping thing and the fish, and to devour one another’s flesh and drink its blood.[a]
Then the earth brought an accusation against the lawless ones.[a]

applications.source_text: ወአዛዝኤል፡ መሀሮሙ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ገቢረ፡ አሰይፍት፡ ወመጣብኅት፡ ወወልታ፡ ወድርዐ፡ አንግድዓ፡ ወአርአዮሙ፡ †ዘእምድኅሬሆሙ፡† ወምግባሮሙ፡ ወእውቃፋተ፡ ወስርጐ፡ ወተጽሕሎተ፡ ወአስንዮተ፡ ቀርንብ፡ ወእብነ፡ *እምኵሉ፡ እብን፡ ክቡረ፡ [ወሕኂረ፡] ወኵሎ፡ ጥምዓታተ፡ ኅብረ፡ [ወተወላጠ፡ ዓለም]።
applications.english: And Azazel taught human beings to make swords, knives, shields, and armor for the shoulders. He showed them what lay behind these[a] and how to make them, as well as bracelets, ornaments, eye paint, the beautifying of the eyelids, every kind of precious and choice stone, and every dye for coloring. And the world was changed.[b]

applications.source_text: ወኮኑ፡ *ርስዓነ፡ [ዓቢየ፡ ወ]ብዙኃ፡ ወዘመዉ፡ ወተሳሕቱ፡ ወ*ማሰኑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ፍናዊሆሙ።
applications.english: And great and widespread wickedness arose. They committed sexual immorality, went astray, and corrupted all their ways.[a]

applications.source_text: አሚዛራክ፡ መሀረ፡ መሳብዕያነ፡ ወመታርያነ፡ ሥርዋት፤ ወ*አርማሮስ፡ ፈትሐ፡ ስብዐታተ፡ ወ*በራቅያል፡ ራዓይያነ፡ ከዋክብት፡ ወኮከብኤል፡ ትእምርታተ፡ ወ*ጠሚኤል፡ መሀረ፡ ርእየ፡ ከከብ፡ ወ*አስድርኤል፡ መሀረ፡ ሩፀተ፡ ወርኅ።
applications.english: Amizarak taught enchantments and the cutting of roots; Armaros, the undoing of spells; Baraqiel, the observation of the stars; Kokabiel, the signs; Tamiel taught the appearance of a star; and Asderel taught the course of the moon.[a][b][c][d][e]

applications.source_text: ወበሕጕሎተ፡ ሰብእ፡ ፀርሑ፡ ወበጽሐ፡ ቃሎሙ፡ ሰማየ።
applications.english: And as humankind was being destroyed, they cried out, and their voice reached heaven.[a]
